name: BoringParty
detailed_description:
BoringParty is an open multiplayer online game platform that allows players to create and experience infinite possible game worlds.

Core features:

Complete multiplayer online system: Create a private room, invite friends, real-time voice communication

Powerful MOD support: Use the Unreal Engine plugin "ModMaker" to easily create game scenes, interactive content and gameplay

Open creation platform: All game content can be customized through mods to create exclusive game experience

Active creator community: Download, share, and play game content created by other players

This is a game platform for creativity. Whether you want to explore in a custom setting with friends or want to realize your own game ideas, BoringParty has you covered.

With the official Unreal Engine plugin, you can easily develop mods:

Create unique game scenarios

Design interaction mechanism

Add new gameplay

Customize role actions

Join our creative community and explore the possibilities!
